title: Prove 100% extraction accuracy for every print in H:/
user_directive: train print ocr reading capabilites to read every print (pdf, pictures and drawing files) | prove we can extract data and dimensions with 100% accurracy for every print in the h drive.
non_goals: Re-implementing BLUEPRINT-OCR-TRAINING-MS1 (already complete: BlueprintExtractionRAGEngine, BlueprintCorpusHarvestEngine, BlueprintLoRABridgeEngine, GroundTruthRegistryEngine, BlueprintCoverageAuditEngine all exist)
Real-time per-PDF UI dashboard (deferred to future MS)
Auto-promoting low-confidence rows to verified_100pct (operator-in-the-loop unconditional per CLAUDE.md)
hard_rules: R12 fail-loud: gate BLOCKS at <100% coverage; never silent rolls up
R2 schema: verified_100pct REQUIRES operatorVerdict=approved AND groundTruthAvailable=true
Operator-in-the-loop: only an operator can flip a row to verified_100pct
No public H:/: knowledge/wiki/lessons/ uses anonymized customer names; LoRA anonymization rule honored

units.title: Corpus print-template Zod schema + writer module
deliverables: PrintCorpusRowSchema (Zod): one row per print with sha256 dedup, scan-status state machine, ground-truth fields, operator-review fields, R2 + R5 refines
PrintCorpusTableWriter: append-only JSONL + sha->byte-offset index, O_EXCL atomic writes, resumable checkpoint, per-customer sub-table mirror
computeWorstFloor + aggregateConfidence helpers for aggregate stats across pages

units.title: Corpus-wide orchestrator (resumable, idempotent)
deliverables: Walks rootDir (default H:/PRISM/JM DIE — 76,166 PDFs counted this session)
Per-file sha256 (1 MB chunks), skips already-scanned via U1's index
Bounded concurrency (default 4 workers)
Failure-isolated: single-file failure writes a row with scanStatus=extraction_failed; scan continues
Injectable extractFn / shaFn / pageCountFn / customerInferFn for tests + alternate backends
CLI: --root --writer-dir --limit --concurrency --formats --dry-run; PRINT_CORPUS_BACKEND=stub|rag

units.title: 100% accuracy proof harness + Stop hook gate
deliverables: classifyRow(): per-row PASS/FAIL verdict with informative reason string for each failure mode
buildReport(): overall coverage %, per-customer breakdown (worst-first sort), rowsRequiringReview list
isOneHundredPercent strictly requires totalRows > 0 (no vacuous PASS)
Stop hook print-accuracy-100pct-gate.mjs: blocks session-end at <100% when active loop task matches the goal directive
Bypass: PRISM_PRINT_ACCURACY_GATE_BYPASS=1 (logged JSONL); Disable: PRISM_PRINT_ACCURACY_GATE_DISABLE=1

units.title: Wiki + tribal batch generator
deliverables: Emits knowledge/wiki/lessons/print-reading-<family>.md (operator-facing lesson per customer family)
Emits knowledge/wiki/code-tribal/blueprint-dim-<dim-type>.md (per dim-type extraction guidance)
Emits state/shared/print-reading-tribal-tips.jsonl (TribalKnowledgeEngine seed: 1 tip per family + top-5 dim-types)
Customer-name ANONYMIZATION: ITW/Optimas/SFS/Fastenal/Holo-Krome -> fastener-family; Alcoa -> aerospace-aluminum-family; null -> general
Mines: byCustomer-cluster stats, dim-type prevalence, floor distribution per family, GD&T patterns per (family, dimType)
Stats reported in each lesson: total prints, avg regions, fail %, dominant floor

side_effect_fix.why: Discovered mid-session that the first tool call after /compact was hard-blocking at 1.04M tokens (actual ctx 291K). cache_read_input_tokens on the compact-summary entry reflects the pre-compact prefix Claude read to GENERATE the summary, not post-compact context size. Fix: when the latest assistant entry IS the compact summary (isCompactSummary:true), return null and let estimateFromBytes() take over.

next_steps: Run scripts/scan-print-corpus.mjs against H:/PRISM/JM DIE (76,166 PDFs) — currently stub backend; PRINT_CORPUS_BACKEND=rag wires BlueprintExtractionRAGEngine for real extraction
Operator review session: triage rowsRequiringReview to push coverage from initial extraction toward 100%
Wire scripts/generate-print-reading-wiki-tribal.mjs into a cron / Stop hook so the wiki + tribal corpus regenerates as rows.jsonl grows
Optional: dispatcher action prism_cad:print_corpus_proof to expose the report via MCP
